title: Liminal Gardens
description: A quiet exploration of overgrown architecture, soft light and the stories left behind.
lede: A quiet exploration of overgrown architecture, soft light and the stories left behind.
mainText: Liminal Gardens is a visual development project about places that have been reclaimed by time. The brief was to create an environment that felt both welcoming and slightly unknowable, using a restrained palette and strong architectural silhouettes.
